360:t_028:1.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「$$マリーダ$$ is watching. We can't screw up.」

360:t_028:2.en:
$$フラスト$$
「Understood. Let's show them the $$ガランシェール$$ team's grit!」

360:t_100:0.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「$$バナージ・リンクス$$! This $$ローゼン・ズール$$ won't lose to your $$ガンダム$$ in power!」

360:t_100:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Is this... Captain $$アンジェロ$$'s hostility...?!」

360:t_100:2.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Prepare yourself! I'll tear off its limbs, crush its head, and take you to the Colonel with nothing left but the cockpit!」

360:t_100:3.en:
$$バナージ$$
「This is dangerous...! If you keep fighting like this, your machine will swallow you up in the end!」

360:t_101:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「If that's what you want...」

360:t_101:3.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「No, $$ギュネイ$$! I'm fighting you to put an end to this ridiculous battle of yours!」

360:t_102:0.en:
$$クェス$$
「You stubborn fool, $$ギュネイ$$! If you want to fight the Colonel and $$カミーユ$$ that badly, you'll have to beat me first!」

360:t_102:1.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Then I have no choice...! I'll get past you, $$クェス$$!」

360:t_102:2.en:
$$クェス$$
「Try it if you can! I won't lose to you when you're so unsure of yourself!」

360:t_103:0.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Today I'll finally surpass you, Colonel!」

360:t_103:1.en:
$$シャア$$
「I still have things I must do, too! I can't give you what you want!」

360:t_103:2.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I'll rip off that mask of composure, $$シャア・アズナブル$$!」

360:t_104:1.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
(...I haven't forgotten you... But right now...)

360:t_104:3.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「...Attack! Shoot down anyone who approaches that spaceship!」

360:t_105:0.en:
$$シンジ$$
(I don't know what's right, or what I should do...)

360:t_105:1.en:
$$シンジ$$
(But I'll fight once more... To protect something... someone...!)

360:t_106:1.en:
$$マリ$$
「You look happy, Princess. Do you want to take this chance to make up with Puppy?」

360:t_106:2.en:
$$アスカ$$
「As if! ...But, well... for now, I'll wait and see...」

360:t_106:3.en:
$$マリ$$
「You really can't be honest, nya~.」

360:t_106:5.en:
$$マリ$$
「Yes, yes. I say it every time, but take that anger out on the enemy.」

360:t_107:1.en:
$$マリーダ$$
(You've let go of your hatred, too... After touching the light in people's hearts...)
